name: riqaa
description: رقعة — لعبة سيطرة على الأراضي داخل Telegram Mini App

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @riqaa/shared && npm run build -w @riqaa/game-core && npm run build -w @riqaa/server-core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @riqaa/server && npm run build -w @riqaa/miniapp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @riqaa/server && npm run typecheck -w @riqaa/miniapp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @riqaa/game-core && npm run test -w @riqaa/server-core
